FULL TEXT:
Walk-In-Interview
for project staff under for Liver-Safe Chandigarh Initiative, under Chandigarh
Administration at Panjab University, Chandigarh
Panjab University, Chandigarh under the Liver-Safe Chandigarh Initiative, Chandigarh for FY
2025-26 is inviting the interested eligible candidates to appear for Walk in Interview for different
temporary posts as mentioned against each Project in different theme area in the attached
Annexures. Eligibility Qualifications, Job Description and corresponding Emoluments are
mentioned against each Project Position in attached Annexures.
S.No. Theme Name Project Title Details of Post
1 Liver-Safe
Chandigarh Initiative
Primordial Prevention of Steatotic Liver
Disease in college students (18-26 years)
of Chandigarh
Annexure - I
Reporting Date and Time: 05 October, 2026 at 11.00 AM
Reporting Venue: PI-RAHI Foundation, Technology Block, South Campus, Panjab
University, Sector 25, Chandigarh
Application Procedure
 All interested candidates may appear for Walk-In-Interview as per the Reporting time at
the reporting Venue mentioned above, along with the duly filled application form available
below.
 Incomplete application forms and applications that are not in proper format may be
summarily rejected.
 Candidates should ensure that the information mentioned in the application form is
accurate. Once the
 application form is submitted no further request regarding any changes/ information in the
application form will be considered.
 The duly filled application form must be submitted at the time of reporting by 11:00 AM
on 05.10.2026.
 The candidates must ascertain their eligibility before applying for different positions, as
ineligible candidates will not be interviewed.
 All the candidates are requested to appear for a walk-in interview with the application
form, experience certificates, publications and original degree certificates and transcripts.
 No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
 Canvassing in any form or bringing influence, political or otherwise, will disqualify the
candidate(s).
Posts are purely on temporary basis and co-terminus with the term period of the project.

 Coordinate screening, risk assessment of college students
for risk factors associated with steatotic liver disease.
 Collect, and maintain clinical and lifestyle data, including
collection of anthropometric, demographic, dietary,
physical activity and relevant health information.
 Assist in data pre-processing, quality checks, coding and
database management for project-related datasets.
 Coordinate with clinicians, college health centres,
students, field teams, investigators and other project
stakeholders for effective implementation of the project.
 Support student and community outreach activities,
including awareness programs on healthy diet, physical
activity, obesity prevention, and other modifiable risk
factors associated with liver health.
 Assist in data analysis, interpretation and preparation of
project reports, presentations, dashboards and research
documentation.
 Support preparation and implementation of Standard
Operating Procedures (SOPs), screening protocols, data-
collection tools and project workflows.
 Organize and coordinate training programs, stakeholder
meetings, workshops and review meetings related to the
project.
 Perform other project task as assigned
